fullTextEN: Okay.
Hello!
I am Ah Hui.

fullTextZH: 今天我要带你去一个特别的地方。
fullTextEN: Today I will take you to a special place.
Let's go!
This city is called Quanzhou.
Quanzhou is in Fujian Province,
in the south of China.
Some people say,
if you like walking,
then you will definitely fall in love with Quanzhou.

fullTextZH: 那今天就跟我一起在泉州散步吧！
fullTextEN: So today, walk with me in Quanzhou!
Look,
there are many people on the street,
and there are also many flowers.
In the past two years,

fullTextZH: 有很多人喜欢来泉州旅游，
fullTextEN: many people like to travel to Quanzhou,

fullTextZH: 因为这里有一种很特别的花，
fullTextEN: because there is a very special flower here,
called Zanhua.

fullTextZH: 很多女孩子会在头上戴很多花，
fullTextEN: Many girls wear many flowers on their heads,
It looks very beautiful.

fullTextZH: 这种花我们叫它簪花围。
fullTextEN: We call this kind of flower 'Zan Hua Wei'.
A long, long time ago,

fullTextZH: 泉州的海边住着很多女人。
fullTextEN: Many women lived by the seaside in Quanzhou.

fullTextZH: 她们每天都要下海打鱼，
fullTextEN: They went fishing in the sea every day,
So we call them 'fisherwomen'.
Their work was very hard:
They had to take a boat,
They had to go to sea,
They had to work all day.

fullTextZH: 但是她们还是会在头上戴花。
fullTextEN: But they still wore flowers on their heads.
Because for them,
Wearing flowers was not just for beauty,
It was also to remind themselves:
I want to live happily.

fullTextZH: 泉州有一句很有名的话：
fullTextEN: There is a famous saying in Quanzhou:
"Wear flowers in this life,
Be beautiful in every life."
It means,
If you wear flowers now,
You will always be very beautiful.
So now in Quanzhou,

fullTextZH: 你可以看到很多人戴花，
fullTextEN: You can see many people wearing flowers,
Many people taking photos.
Everyone wants to 'wear flowers in this life,
be beautiful for generations'.

fullTextZH: 你是不是觉得这里人太多了？
fullTextEN: Do you think there are too many people here?
Go to the store to buy things,
Go to the restaurant to eat,
Go to the drink shop to have milk tea,
Have coffee,
Go take beautiful photos—

fullTextZH: 你会想，泉州只是一个热闹的城市吗？
fullTextEN: You might think, is Quanzhou just a bustling city?
No, no, no!
Now please follow me.
We leave the main road,
Choose a small path—
We also call it a small alley,
Walk in.
You will find,

fullTextZH: 真正的泉州在这些安静的小路里。
fullTextEN: The real Quanzhou is in these quiet little streets.
Look,
There is a well here.
A long time ago,

fullTextZH: 泉州人每天来这里取水，
fullTextEN: Quanzhou people came here every day to fetch water,
and took it home to use.

fullTextZH: 他们用这里的水洗衣服、做饭、洗澡。
fullTextEN: They used the water here to wash clothes, cook, and bathe.

fullTextZH: 这口井已经在这里几百年了。
fullTextEN: This well has been here for hundreds of years.
It knows the grandfather of this family,
and also knows the children of that family.

fullTextZH: 现在人们不用来这里打水了，
fullTextEN: Now people don't come here to draw water anymore,
but the well is still here.

fullTextZH: 它在这里，看着时间慢慢过去。
fullTextEN: It is here, watching time slowly pass by.
Keep walking forward,

fullTextZH: 你还会看到一家很小的茶叶店。
fullTextEN: you will also see a very small tea shop.
This shop is not big, nor is it new,
but it has been open for many years.
Since 1983,

fullTextZH: 他们家就在这里卖茶叶。
fullTextEN: their family has been selling tea here.
Quanzhou people really like drinking tea.
If you stand at the door,

fullTextZH: 店里的爷爷可能会对你说：
fullTextEN: The grandpa in the shop might say to you:
"Come in and have a seat,
have a cup of tea!"

fullTextZH: 他会给你讲讲这里有什么茶，
fullTextEN: He will tell you about the teas here,
and chat with you about where you're from,
and what's fun in Quanzhou.

fullTextZH: 在泉州，喝茶不只是为了喝水，
fullTextEN: In Quanzhou, drinking tea is not just for drinking water,
it's also for chatting with friends.
We continue to head out and walk forward—
Wait a moment,
please take a look at this wall.

fullTextZH: 这里有一尊小的菩萨像。
fullTextEN: Here is a small statue of a Bodhisattva.
Why is he in the wall?

fullTextZH: 泉州是一个有很多神的城市，
fullTextEN: Quanzhou is a city with many gods,
many people here believe in Buddhism,
and believe in God.
But more than 50 years ago,

fullTextZH: 中国有一个很特别的时期。
fullTextEN: China had a very special period.

fullTextZH: 那个时候有些人不相信神，
fullTextEN: At that time, some people didn't believe in gods,

fullTextZH: 他们也不让别人相信神。
fullTextEN: They also don't let others believe in gods.
They think this is fake,
bad,
and superstitious.
So at that time,
many Buddha statues were thrown away,
discarded.
This Bodhisattva was

fullTextZH: 那个时候被丢到了垃圾桶里。
fullTextEN: thrown into the trash can at that time.

fullTextZH: 但是泉州人很爱他们的文化。
fullTextEN: But the people of Quanzhou love their culture very much.
There was a family,

fullTextZH: 他们偷偷把菩萨从垃圾桶里捡回来，
fullTextEN: they secretly picked the Bodhisattva out of the trash can,
and hid it in this wall.
After a long time,

fullTextZH: 终于人们又可以开始信佛、
fullTextEN: finally people could start believing in Buddha again,
believe in God,
or believe in nothing at all—
all are acceptable.
At this time, the Bodhisattva once again
returned to everyone's sight.

fullTextZH: 所以你看到的，不只是一个佛像，
fullTextEN: So what you see is not just a Buddha statue,

fullTextZH: 也是泉州人对自己文化的爱。
fullTextEN: but also the love Quanzhou people have for their own culture.
In the alleys of Quanzhou,
if you walk slowly,

fullTextZH: 你还会发现一件很重要的东西。
fullTextEN: you will also discover something very important.

fullTextZH: 很多房子的门口都有一块牌匾。
fullTextEN: At the entrance of many houses, there is a plaque.
Through it,

fullTextZH: 你可以知道这家人姓什么。
fullTextEN: you can know the family name of the household.
Now,
let's take a look at this gate.
I want to tell you about
a very special family in Quanzhou—
the You family.
A long, long time ago,

fullTextZH: 刘家一直有很多人做官。
fullTextEN: the Liu family always had many officials.

fullTextZH: 他们给当时的皇帝工作。
fullTextEN: They worked for the emperor at that time.
Later,
a dynasty ended,
a new dynasty began—
a new emperor came.
The patriarch of the Liu family,

fullTextZH: 也就是他们家最重要的那个人，
fullTextEN: who is the most important person in their family,
he said:
"We should not work for the new emperor,
we must have our own principles."

fullTextZH: 为了不给新的皇帝工作，
fullTextEN: In order not to work for the new emperor,
this patriarch eventually committed suicide.

fullTextZH: 他觉得，有些事情比金钱和地位更重要。
fullTextEN: He felt that some things are more important than money and status.

fullTextZH: 于是这家人以后不再给皇帝做官，
fullTextEN: So this family no longer served as officials for the emperor,
they chose to become doctors.
They studied medicine,
treated ordinary people,
and helped the sick.
Generation after generation,

fullTextZH: 他们做的都是同样的事情——
fullTextEN: they did the same thing—
which is helping and saving people.
Even up to now,
their family's clinic is still in
Quanzhou, helping the sick.

fullTextZH: 他们的儿子现在也在学医。
fullTextEN: Their son is now also studying medicine.
So,
When you stand in front of that plaque,

fullTextZH: 你看到的，不只是一个姓，
fullTextEN: What you see is not just a surname,
What you see is this family's
choices made over generations.

fullTextZH: 他们不是一定要把名字传下去，
fullTextEN: They don't necessarily want to pass down the name,

fullTextZH: 也不是一定要让孩子做同样的工作。
fullTextEN: nor do they necessarily want their children to do the same work.
What they truly want to leave behind,
is not 'who we are',

fullTextZH: 而是“我们要做一个什么样的人”。
fullTextEN: but 'what kind of person we want to be'.
Walking around Quanzhou,

fullTextZH: 你还可以把它当成一个小游戏。
fullTextEN: you can also treat it as a little game.
You can walk and search at the same time—
What are you searching for?
You can look for patterned tiles.
Different patterned tiles are very beautiful,
right?

fullTextZH: 但是这些都是从外国来的哦！
fullTextEN: But these all came from abroad!
A long time ago,

fullTextZH: 很多外国人从海上来到泉州。
fullTextEN: many foreigners came to Quanzhou by sea.
They come here to do business,

fullTextZH: 留下了他们国家的文化。
fullTextEN: leaving behind the culture of their country.
You can find Shigandang—
a special stone,
it's hidden by the wall,
it looks very cute.

fullTextZH: 泉州人相信它在保护这条街。
fullTextEN: Quanzhou people believe it protects this street.
You can find the Wind Lion God—

fullTextZH: 一块看起来像狮子的石头。
fullTextEN: a stone that looks like a lion.
Quanzhou is near the sea,
so there are often typhoons.
Everyone thinks the wind is bad,
it can make the body sick.
The Wind Lion God looks a bit fierce,
also a bit like a cute dog.

fullTextZH: 人们相信它可以帮助人们挡风、
fullTextEN: People believe it can help block the wind,
block typhoons,
and scare away typhoons.
You can also look at the roof—
there are carp on the roof.

fullTextZH: 你猜猜它是干什么用的呢？
fullTextEN: Can you guess what it's used for?
Where do fish live?
Water!
That's right!
So it represents water.

fullTextZH: 人们相信，它能够让房子不着火。
fullTextEN: People believe it can prevent the house from catching fire.
Walking in Quanzhou,
You don't need to rush anywhere.
You just need to walk into the alleys,
Walk slowly,
Look slowly, see the people here—
What have they experienced,
What do they believe,
How do they live.
Alright,

fullTextZH: 今天的散步就到这里啦！
fullTextEN: Today's walk ends here!

fullTextZH: 你喜欢在旅游的时候散步吗？
fullTextEN: Do you like to walk when traveling?

fullTextZH: 下一次再带你看不一样的泉州！
fullTextEN: Next time, I'll show you a different Quanzhou!
